note: Cooking placeholder (until the cook and food systems exist): at a lit fire, one raw forage item becomes Roasted forage. A gathered item cooks when its id ends with one of these words.
fuel_note: Burn times in GAME seconds (clock is 24:1): a stick 2 game minutes, driftwood 15, firewood 30, a log 2 game hours. A placed campfire starts lit with 20 sticks of fuel.
